summary.text: Leslie Rossi is a Republican state representative from Westmoreland County who has represented Pennsylvania House District 59 since 2021 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
She is a small business owner and real estate developer.

paragraphs.text: Rossi describes herself as a lifelong Westmoreland County resident who lives in Unity Township with her husband and family.

Her official biography says she is a small business owner and real estate developer with more than two decades of experience, and that before her election she volunteered as a leader of the Greater Latrobe Hockey program and created its Little Wildcat Development program.
Rossi was elected on May 18, 2021, and her biography describes her as the first woman to represent the 59th Legislative District.
Ballotpedia lists her as assuming office on June 7, 2021.
Her biography lists her top priorities as election integrity reform, eliminating wasteful spending, reducing taxes, Second Amendment rights and protecting human life.
Democrat Jordan Omlor is her opponent in the general election, according to Ballotpedia.
